selection_reason: First unused completed AM edition after the 2026-09-24 AM development case. Selected before inspecting source titles or article text.
source_selection: Historical originals collected no later than cutoff, published within 30 hours, registered enabled use_for_summary sources with matching digest, relevant title or official kind; up to 48 per origin and 600 total, then unchanged selection version 3 and at most 16 excerpts. No current lake backfill or search retrofitted.
repair: At most one full proposal/condition repair after confirmed failure; preserve original draft and combined rejections. No uncertain replay.
pass: All twelve semantic checks true, verdict publish, no mechanical rejections, core US closes observed or explicitly missing, no quote conflicts. Same-model review is not independent expert certification.
offline_scope: Actual cached original articles and official subscription provider; no Slack send or scheduled execution.
existing_uncertain_request_policy: The prior Claude request from another case is not replayed. A new independent review, if attempted, uses a distinct new case ID and preserves any uncertain result.
